parameters.jsCode:
const d = $input.first().json;
return [{ json: { bot_id: d.bot_id, user_id: d.user_id, q: String(d.query || '').trim() } }];

parameters.query: SELECT json_agg(x ORDER BY fav DESC, created_at DESC) AS recipes FROM (SELECT id, title, kcal_per_serving AS kcal, protein_g_per_serving AS protein, fat_g_per_serving AS fat, carb_g_per_serving AS carb, prep_minutes AS prep, tags, status, (status='favorite') AS fav, created_at FROM recipe WHERE bot_id=$1 AND user_id=$2 AND ($3='' OR title ILIKE '%'||$3||'%' OR tags::text ILIKE '%'||$3||'%') LIMIT 10) x;
